parameters.query:
UPDATE canonical_asset_registry
SET
  is_canonical = false,
  status = 'selected',
  review_notes = '{{ $json.reviewNotesSql }}',
  metadata = jsonb_set(
    jsonb_set(
      COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
      '{status}', '"selected"'
    ),
    '{isCanonical}', 'false'
  )
WHERE asset_id = '{{ $json.assetId }}'
  AND is_canonical = false
  AND COALESCE(status, '') <> 'canonical'
RETURNING
  asset_id,
  sha256,
  avatar,
  asset_type,
  scene,
  bucket,
  object_path,
  mime_type,
  status,
  is_canonical,
  canonical_group,
  review_notes,
  created_at;
